verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not show a built-in AI assistant inside Canny that users can delegate tasks to. The AI-related evidence describes Canny's MCP server, which exposes Canny data and actions to external LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor), so the assistant lives outside the product. Autopilot is described only as automatic feedback capture from other sources, which is an adjacent automation feature rather than an assistant you hand tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
